Sandbox_TienCoolers_CoolStrength_tooltip: How much of a working refrigerator's cooling an iced cooler manages. 1 makes it the equal of a fridge, 0.5 gets it half way there, and 0 means the ice does nothing at all. It is measured against whatever your Refrigeration Effectiveness setting gives a real fridge, so the two move together; at the default 0.5 and Normal refrigeration, food in a cooler rots at 0.6 of its usual speed. A cooler is never allowed to beat a fridge, which is why the scale stops at 1.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_IceLifeHours_tooltip: In-game hours one full bag of ice lasts inside a cooler at 20 C. Hot weather burns through it faster, cold weather slower.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_IceLifeOutsideMult_t: Multiplier applied to ice lifetime when the ice is not in a cooler. 0.2 means it melts five times faster in a backpack.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_FreezeHours_tooltip: In-game hours a powered freezer needs to turn water into ice, and to refill a melted bag of ice. With Reworked Ice on, it is the time water set to freeze takes to turn to ice, however much of it there is.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_WaterPerBag_tooltip: Units of water consumed per bag of ice produced. Water pools across every container set to freeze in the same fridge, so several small ones can add up to a bag. For scale, a bottle holds 1 unit and a bucket 10. With Reworked Ice on, a full bag of ice also weighs as much as this much water, plus the bag.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_ReworkedIce_tooltip: Beta feature, off by default. Makes ice behave like the water it is made of. Tainted water freezes into a Bag of Ice (Tainted), which cools food just as well but melts into tainted water, and a clean bag topped up with tainted water becomes tainted. Each new bag of ice needs an empty plastic bag or garbage bag in the freezer, given back when the ice is used up. A bottle, pot or other water container inside a cooler can be set to catch the water from the ice melting beside it. Water set to freeze turns to ice a little at a time, filling one bag before starting the next, and water short of a full bag makes a partly filled one. A melted bag fills up again only from water set to freeze beside it, and a bag weighs as much as the water in it. When off, the mod plays as it always has.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_UseColdpacks_tooltip: Lets the vanilla Cold Pack chill a cooler too, at the strength set below.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_ColdpackPower_toolti: How much cooling one Cold Pack is worth, where 1 is a full bag of ice. 0 turns them off, the same as the switch above.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_SpawnIceInLoot_toolt: Adds bags of ice to freezer loot. Turn off to make freezing your own water the only source.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_ShowColdTint_tooltip: Chills the items in an iced cooler so the inventory window tints their rows blue, the same cue a powered fridge gives. Turn off to leave item temperature alone.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_RenameCoolers_toolti: Adds (Iced) to the name of a cooler that currently holds ice.
